bindingInterpretation: The specification extends and preserves the existing Motazen project.
Every track claimed complete must have its own 100 full distinct days.
The first execution is Parts A through S in order for Track #1, not immediate production UI coding.
AI critical-lens reports may support red-teaming but cannot be labeled professional human approval.
Existing product files remain preserved until the content and handoff system is implementation-ready.
